verdict.rationale: Supabase's own Branching docs describe separate environments spun off the main project, with isolated preview environments for each pull request, so the core per-PR database branch capability is first-party. The pack does not show how branches are created automatically from CI or a deploy platform, or that they are torn down when the PR closes. missing for 10: documented automatic branch teardown on PR merge/close, documented CI or deploy-platform triggering (e.g. GitHub/Vercel integration or a branch API/CLI command), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can create and tear down per-pull-request database branches automatically from CI or my deploy platform

citations.quote: Branching takes this further, adding isolated preview environments for each pull request.
Supabase branches create separate environments that spin off from your main project.
